content.description: Camshaft housing alignment diagram showing exhaust and intake sides with match hole alignment detail

content.text: Make sure that the match hole of camshaft housing is aligned with that of the camshaft.

content.description: Using magnet to remove match pin from camshaft timing pulley pin hole

content.text: Using a magnet, remove the match pin from the pin hole of the camshaft timing pulley.
Set the No. 1 cylinder to TDC/compression.

content.description: Camshaft timing pulley showing overlapped pin holes with detail inset of overlapped holes

content.text: There are three pin holes on the camshaft and timing pulley. Select one overlapped hole and insert the match pin into it.

items: If there is no overlapping hole, find one that is nearly overlapped and rotate the crankshaft slightly to overlap it, and then insert the pin.
The crankshaft pulley angle can be adjust approximately 3° by changing the pin hole to the next one.

content.description: Installing pulley set bolt using SST tool on camshaft timing pulley

content.text: Using SST to hold the camshaft timing pulley, install the pulley set bolt.
CAUTION: Do not make use of the timing belt tension when tightening the bolt.

content.description: Crankshaft pulley showing alignment and TDC/compression setting with timing belt cover

content.text: Turn the crankshaft clockwise two times and set the No. 1 cylinder to TDC/compression.
Recheck the crankshaft pulley angle on the No. 1 timing belt light cover after alignment of the camshaft match hole.
